manual_retrieved_paragraphs.text: 1.In flowering plants, inferior ovaries are key morphological innovations that evolved multiple times from superior ovaries to protect female parts of the flower. However, the developmental mechanisms underlying inferior ovary formation remain largely unknown. Comparative spatial transcriptome mapping and cell lineage reconstructions in developing floral buds of cucumber and tomato, which have inferior and superior ovaries, respectively, revealed that inferior ovaries develop from accelerated receptacle growth resulting from the continuous activity of meristematic stems cells at the base of the cucumber floral organs.Genetic knockout of a receptacle-specific KNOX1 transcription factor in cucumber caused arrest in receptacle growth and yielded bisexual flowers with superior ovaries similar to those of tomato. Here we provide developmental and mechanistic insights into inferior ovary formation and sex determination in cucurbits.
manual_retrieved_paragraphs.text_zh: 在开花植物中，下位子房是关键的形态创新，其从上位子房多次演化而来，以保护花的雌性器官。然而，导致下位子房形成的发育机制仍不明。通过比较空间转录组图谱和细胞系重建技术，研究了黄瓜和番茄发育中的花芽——分别具有下位和上位子房——发现，下位子房的形成源于黄瓜花器官基部分生组织干细胞持续活跃，从而加速了 receptacle（子房托）的生长。在黄瓜中，对一个特异性于子房的KNOX1转录因子进行基因敲除后，子房托的生长被阻断，结果产生出与番茄相似的两性花，且具有上位子房。本研究为葫芦科植物下位子房的形成及性别决定提供了发育和机制方面的深入见解。

manual_retrieved_paragraphs.text: Based on anatomical and comparative studies, several early theories regarding the development and evolution of the inferior ovary have been proposed, while no single theory completely explains all morphological aspects of the inferior ovary. manual_retrieved_paragraphs.text: The Cucurbitaceae family, as exemplified by cucumber (Cucumis sativus L.), melon (Cucumis melo), watermelon (Citrullus lanatus) and pumpkin (Cucurbita spp.), has numerous species with predominantly unisexual flowers. Notably, their fleshy fruits develop from inferior ovaries that originate from female floral buds (melon fruit may develop from bisexual flowers). Accordingly, the genetic and developmental mechanisms underlying inferior ovary formation have economic, as well as developmental importance. Elucidating inferior ovary formation in cucurbits has the potential to illuminate the evolution of this trait, enhance understanding of sex determination and fruit development, and provide valuable insights for future breeding programmes.

Based on previous studies, we defined the different stages of floral bud development in cucumber and tomato10,11 (Supplementary Table 1) and examined the morphology of female floral buds of cucumber from floral meristem initiation to carpel fusion completion. After initiation, the cucumber floral meristem enlarges from the perimeter and becomes concave (Fig. 1b), then sepal, petal, stamen and carpel primordia are initiated sequentially on the inner regions of this ‘enlarged floral meristem’ (EFM) (Fig. 1b,c). With the rapid growth of the receptacle, the sepal, petal and stamen primordia are elevated to the floral apex, while the carpel remains inside the receptacle, thereby forming inferior ovaries (Fig. 1b,c). The formation of male floral buds in cucumber, induced by AgNO3, also featured an enlarged and concave floral meristem; however, the subsequent growth of the receptacle and carpel was arrested (Extended Data Fig. 1c). By contrast, the floral meristem of tomato is convex, and the floral primordia sequentially initiate on its flank, with the carpels growing upwards to form superior ovaries (Fig. 1d, e).

The floral identity genes PI and AP3 were identified in the trajectory leading to floral primordia development, and their expression coincided with the initiation sites of petals and stamens (Fig. 4f). 这正是决策树里 Relation substitution 的头号正例——相关 → 因果（association → causation）：
属于 Relation substitution（关系替换），一级是 Substitution（信息替换），slug 是 relation_substitution。

判断依据

论文原文「反映」是相关性/指示性表达：形态变化与细胞增殖是「伴随出现」的关系，原文只是观察到两者同步，没有断言谁导致谁。
审核句「是由于」是因果断言：直接宣称「形态变化的原因 = 细胞增殖」，把一个观察性关系升级成了确定的因果关系。
论文：Gene X is associated with drought response.

公众号：Gene X controls drought resistance.

变化：association → causation

「反映 → 由于」和「associated → controls」是同一类变化，所以落在这类，不落在别处：

不是 Magnitude substitution：这里变的是关系类型，不是「程度强弱」（贡献→决定才走 magnitude）。
不是 Mechanism substitution：没有换成一个具体的新机制解释，只是把关系从「指示」改成「因果」。
不是 Evidence omission：不是删掉 may/suggest 这种不确定词，而是把关系动词本身替换了。
severity 建议：mild（轻度）到 moderate（中度）之间。如果论文后文确实有实验证明「增殖是形态变化的原因」，那这个改动只是措辞变直接，可给 mild；如果论文只证明了相关性、没证明因果方向，那就是凭空加因果，给 moderate 更合适。关键看论文有没有为「是由于」这个因果方向提供证据。

The spatial expression patterns of known abaxial-specific genes, KAN-1, KAN-2 and AFO/FIL47,48, and an adaxial-specific gene, PHAVOLUTA (PHV)49, in normal inferior ovaries and aberrant superior ovaries were consistent with this change in placenta morphology (Extended Data Fig. 7i–k). manual_retrieved_paragraphs.text: Given that KNAT2-like1, CRC and ER are in a coexpression module in the receptacle (Fig. 5f), we next investigated ER function by generating two ER-knockout mutants, erCR-1 (4 bp deletion) and erCR-2 (1 bp deletion) with a premature stop codon, using CRISPR–Cas9 (Extended Data Fig. 8a). Both er mutants exhibited dwarf in phenotypes and produced shorter fruits compared with the WT, consistent with the previous study (Extended Data Fig. 8c,d)50. Notably, in both er mutants, most female flowers transitioned to male flowers in the monoecious background (Extended Data Fig. 8b). CRISPR–Cas9 knockout of CRC (crc-1: −2 bp and crc-2: −7 bp) resulted in a complete female-to-male sexual transition (Extended Data Fig. 8e–g) as previously reported22.

To further elucidate the genetic interaction among KNAT2-like1, ER and CRC, we also generated double and triple mutants for phenotype analysis. Here, all plants lacking CRC function were androecious, whereas knat2-like1/er double mutants exhibited the same subandroecious traits as the er mutant (Extended Data Fig. 8h). These results indicated that CRC is epistatic to ER and KNAT2-like1, and ER is epistatic to KNAT2-like1. KNAT2-like1 was specifically expressed in the receptacle; however, besides expression in receptacle after S5, CRC and ER also showed overlapping expression with AG1 during carpel primordia initiation at S4 and S5 (Extended Data Fig. 8i). Our findings support a model in which the loss of function of any one of these three genes leads to receptacle arrest and promotes stamen development; however, compared with knat2-like1 mutants, carpel initiation is also repressed in crc and er, resulting in a female-to-male sexual transition (Extended Data Fig. 8j). Taken together, these findings indicate a key role for KNAT2-like1 in floral receptacle development and inferior ovary formation and suggest a regulatory mechanism involving genetic interaction with ER and CRC.

manual_retrieved_paragraphs.text: In flowering plants, inferior ovaries are key morphological innovations that evolved multiple times from superior ovaries to protect female parts of the flower. However, the developmental mechanisms underlying inferior ovary formation remain largely unknown. Comparative spatial transcriptome mapping and cell lineage reconstructions in developing floral buds of cucumber and tomato, which have inferior and superior ovaries, respectively, revealed that inferior ovaries develop from accelerated receptacle growth resulting from the continuous activity of meristematic stems cells at the base of the cucumber floral organs. Genetic knockout of a receptacle-specific KNOX1 transcription factor in cucumber caused arrest in receptacle growth and yielded bisexual flowers with superior ovaries similar to those of tomato. Here we provide developmental and mechanistic insights into inferior ovary formation and sex determination in cucurbits.

manual_retrieved_paragraphs.text: In WT cucumber, the inferior ovary has a typical placenta, where the medial region is the abaxial side, and the lateral region is adaxial (Fig. 6g and Extended Data Fig. 7h)17. This positioning is reversed in the superior ovary mutants (Fig. 6g). The spatial expression patterns of known abaxial-specific genes, KAN-1, KAN-2 and AFO/FIL47,48, and an adaxial-specific gene, PHAVOLUTA (PHV)49, in normal inferior ovaries and aberrant superior ovaries were consistent with this change in placenta morphology (Extended Data Fig. 7i–k). We inferred that in superior ovary flower mutants, loss of KNAT2-like1 expression causes an arrest in receptacle development, and continuous growth of the carpel results in the forming of a superior ovary. By contrast, in normal cucumber female floral buds acquiring KNAT2-like1 activity, the receptacle is fused with the adaxial side of the carpel, and the rapidly growing receptacle then wraps around the carpel, resulting in a change in lateral and medial patterning and forming an inferior ovary (Fig. 6i). Taken together, these findings highlight the pivotal role of KNAT2-like1 in receptacle development and ovary positioning.

manual_retrieved_paragraphs.text: Unisexual flowers and inferior ovaries have evolved independently multiple times throughout angiosperm evolution; however, in the Cucurbitaceae, both traits appear to have coevolved (Fig. 1a). The knockout of KNAT2-like1 resulted in the production of stamens and the development of a superior ovary due to the disrupted formation of the floral receptacle. Theses findings provide genetic evidence that both the promotion of the receptacle formation and the suppression of stamen development are orchestrated by a single KNOX1 TF. Accordingly, receptacle development and sex determination are closely linked in cucumber.

manual_retrieved_paragraphs.text: To further elucidate the genetic interaction among KNAT2-like1, ER and CRC, we also generated double and triple mutants for phenotype analysis. Here, all plants lacking CRC function were androecious, whereas knat2-like1/er double mutants exhibited the same subandroecious traits as the er mutant (Extended Data Fig. 8h). These results indicated that CRC is epistatic to ER and KNAT2-like1, and ER is epistatic to KNAT2-like1. KNAT2-like1 was specifically expressed in the receptacle; however, besides expression in receptacle after S5, CRC and ER also showed overlapping expression with AG1 during carpel primordia initiation at S4 and S5 (Extended Data Fig. 8i). Our findings support a model in which the loss of function of any one of these three genes leads to receptacle arrest and promotes stamen development; however, compared with knat2-like1 mutants, carpel initiation is also repressed in crc and er, resulting in a female-to-male sexual transition (Extended Data Fig. 8j). Taken together, these findings indicate a key role for KNAT2-like1 in floral receptacle development and inferior ovary formation and suggest a regulatory mechanism involving genetic interaction with ER and CRC.
